info.description: Motorsport program and campaign hubs such as IJTC and FIA Rallycross. The FIA Rallycross event detail URL is managed by the program with slug fia-rallycross-world-cup-indonesia-2026.

edit.description: 01 — Hero and information band. This is the first presentation group rendered on the programme page. Edit Hero first, then Information Band.

02 — Legacy programme fallback image for IJTC and other non-Rallycross programmes. Recommended 2400 × 1200 px (2:1). FIA Rallycross uses Motorsport Presentation > Hero instead; this field is hidden for FIA programmes.
03 — FIA Rallycross campaign slides shown after the hero and information band. Add the image, title, description, CTA, and order for each slide. This field is shown only for Rallycross programmes.
Shared programme sections used by IJTC and non-Rallycross programme pages. FIA Rallycross editors should use FIA Rallycross Content instead.

03 — FIA Rallycross content group. Edit Format, Rundown, and Race-day Guide only in their matching sections; each section contains its own presentation copy and items. Shown only for Rallycross programmes.
Short localized label used in the Motorsport Event navigation dropdown.
Shared schedule rows used by IJTC and non-Rallycross programme pages. FIA Rallycross editors should use FIA Rallycross Content > Rundown instead.
Public programme name used in page headings, navigation, cards, and metadata.
Stable URL identifier for this programme. Change only with a redirect/migration plan.
Show this programme in the Motorsport Event navigation menu.
Choose the programme family. This controls the documented field guidance for Rallycross, IJTC, race weekends, and other programmes.
Public visibility and lifecycle state. Hidden programmes are excluded from Motorsport routes and menus.
Short season label shown beside the programme name, for example 2026 Season.
Primary programme introduction used in the hero and programme summaries.
Optional campaign headline shown as the main programme hero title.
Programme start date used for date ranges and campaign metadata.
Programme end date used with the start date for public date ranges.
Primary venue shown in programme metrics and campaign ticket context.
Fallback primary action label used when a presentation Hero or ticket CTA does not provide one.
Fallback primary action destination. Use a local route or approved HTTPS URL.
IJTC inquiry action label shown on programme pages. Leave empty for the standard label. This field is shown only for IJTC programmes.
IJTC inquiry action destination. Use the programme-relative become-riders route unless an approved alternative is required. This field is shown only for IJTC programmes.
Optional events related to this programme for future cross-linking and editorial context.
Approved ticket destinations for this programme. Add one active partner CTA; checkout remains external.
Ticket map shown immediately before the ticket card on the FIA Rallycross programme page. Set Show ticket map to false to hide it without removing the artwork.
IJTC rider records shown in the rider catalogue and linked standings. Not used by FIA Rallycross pages.
IJTC classification records shown on the standings page. Not used by FIA Rallycross pages.
IJTC approved sporting regulation records shown on the regulation page. Not used by FIA Rallycross pages.
Site visibility scope. Use motorsport for the dedicated Motorsport frontend; hidden excludes the record from public queries.
Optional site assignments used by shared multisite filtering.
Search and social metadata for this programme. Leave blank to use the mapped title, summary, and hero image.
